title: Spreader
description: Plugin that allows to teleport player to specific position in the world
body:
# Spreader
Spreader is a plugin that allows you to teleport players to specific locations.

## 📥 Available Commands

### /savespawn

Description: Saves your current position for teleportation

Permission: spreader.savespawn

Usage: Simply run the command at the location you want to save

### /spreader

Description: Teleports players to the saved positions in order

Permission: spreader.spreader

Usage: Run the command to teleport all players (except operators) to the saved positions

### /listpositions

Description: Lists all saved positions

Permission: spreader.listpositions

Usage: Displays all saved positions with their coordinates

### /clearpositions

Description: Deletes all saved positions

Permission: spreader.clearpositions

Usage: Clears all saved positions

### /testposition

Description: Allows operators to test positions one by one

Permission: spreader.testpositions

### Usage:

/testposition – Shows all available positions

/testposition <number> – Teleports the operator to the specific position

/spreaderinfo

Description: Shows detailed plugin information

Permission: spreader.info

Usage: /spreaderinfo – Displays plugin status, statistics, and available commands

## 📦 How to Use

Saving Positions:

Go to the locations where you want to teleport players

Run /savespawn at each location

Positions are saved in the order you set them

Teleporting Players:

Run /spreader

Players will be teleported in order to the saved positions

Operators (OPs) are automatically ignored

Managing Positions:

Use /listpositions to view all saved positions

Use /clearpositions to delete all saved positions

Use /testposition to test positions as an operator

Use /spreaderinfo to see plugin information

## ⚙️ Features
✅ Automatic teleportation ignoring OPs
✅ Ordered position system
✅ Informative messages

## 📜 Permissions
All commands require specific permissions:

spreader.savespawn – Save positions

spreader.spreader – Teleport players

spreader.listpositions – List positions

spreader.clearpositions – Clear positions

spreader.testpositions – Test positions as operator

spreader.info – View plugin information

By default, all permissions are set to op.

## 🧪 Example Usage

Go to different locations and use /savespawn to save each position

When ready, run /spreader

Players will be automatically teleported to the saved positions in order

## 💾 Position Storage
Positions are automatically saved in the file:
plugins/Spreader/positions.yml
